verdict.rationale: Together's own docs say serverless models are billed with per-token pricing, and a community user quotes a concrete public per-token price and self-serve signup with a $25 credit, so pricing appears transparent without sales contact. The pack contains no published price list showing rates for every hosted model, and dedicated and provisioned-throughput pricing is not shown publicly. missing for 10: a documented public pricing page covering every hosted model, published per-token rates for cached input and batch tiers, and evidence that dedicated and provisioned pricing is self-serve.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: Call 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing and no provisioning latency.
4B MODEL, PRICE 1K TOKENS: $0.0001. register with an email, test account has $25 credit
